reuse.why: Folds the averaging actions onto the existing setNMonthAvg and one fillCategories loop, but isFixedGroup hand-rolls a #tag regex instead of using the existing shared/tags helpers (extractTagsFromText).

duplication.why: setZero/set*MonthAvg/setLastMonthSpending share one selection, but copyPreviousMonth re-applies the hidden, saved-template and #fixed exclusions inline on getBudgetData rows, and the notes join is written twice in SQL.

placement.why: Selection and fill helpers live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings; tag parsing would belong with shared/tags.

scope.why: Changes stay on month-wide actions, though set3MonthAvg is also swapped from getCategoryAverage to setNMonthAvg as an incidental rewrite.

maintainability.why: getFillableCategories/fillCategories is a good single entry point, but the exclusion rule lives in two places (it plus copyPreviousMonth), so the next exclusion has to be added twice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in server/budget/actions.ts applies the exclusions itself instead of using getFillableCategories; isFixedGroup bypasses shared/tags tag parsing

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the getFillableCategories rule (hidden/group_hidden, hasSavedTemplates, isFixedGroup) as separate early returns over getBudgetData rows, with the notes join duplicated into getBudgetData's SQL

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories/fillCategories gain includeHiddenCategories; copyPreviousMonth re-implements the selection rule rather than calling getFillableCategories
